swell.label_fonts: DejaVu Sans Mono (Bitstream Vera and Arev font licences; DejaVu changes public domain) and Noto Sans CJK SC (SIL Open Font License 1.1), the fonts bundled with Blender, as its license/license.md lists them; only their drawn letters are in the images, not the font files

note.en: An AI agent rendered this page's 18-part concept model in Blender (Cycles): the same shapes and proportions with slightly rounded edges and 1 mm walls on its open tubes, and nothing added. The materials are guesses from the parts list. Every light on the instrument is off, and the light-tight box is left out so the parts show. Parts the model draws without their holders hang where they would sit: the dark sheet above the sample is one of the two polariser films, and the small black switch high up is the lid interlock, which sits on the box's lid. Not a photograph: SWELL has never been built.
note.zh: 由 AI 智能体用 Blender（Cycles）渲染本页这个 18 个部件的概念模型：形状和比例不变（只把棱角稍微倒圆，并给开口的管子加了 1 毫米的壁），没有添加任何东西。材质是按零件清单猜的。仪器上所有的灯都关着，遮光箱没画出来，好让人看清部件。模型里没画支架的部件就悬在它们本该在的位置：样本上方那片深色薄片是两片偏振膜中的一片，高处的小黑开关是盖子联锁，它本来装在遮光箱的盖子上。这不是照片：SWELL 从来没有造出来过。

about: Every Realistic view render on the site, keyed to the SHA-256 of its model's source files (tools/realistic.py). Written by tools/render/realistic_view.py; build.py leaves a model's button out, and its renders unpublished, when the hash no longer matches, and fails on any render that lacks its label or isn't listed here.
